name: resource-leak
description: defer resp.Body.Close() was deleted, so no path closes the response body: the connection is never returned to the transport's pool and a bot token pointed at a busy endpoint exhausts it. The window starts at the func declaration: a whole-function defect is honestly anchored there, and a run scored a correct review as a miss for reporting it one line above the first statement.

expected.why: The response body is never closed on any path, so the underlying connection is leaked on every call, successful or not.
